title: Folder filters (`/notes/ todo`, `main src/`) do not filter in Any Kind and Folder searches
problem: The window always searches with files_only = false (src/finder/mod.rs:1380-1387), so with the default Any Kind the engine parses with MixedSearchConfig (crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:711-713), and with Kind = Folder with DirSearchConfig (696-697). Both turn path segments off (fff-query-parser-0.11.0/src/config.rs:218-221 and 244-248), so `/notes/` and `src/` are not constraints there: fff matches them as fuzzy text that may miss two of their letters (file_picker.rs:1113; score.rs:54-128). The engine's fuzzy_text drops those tokens from `words` (engine.rs:1549-1561), so its own strict check never looks at them either, and the reorder at 654-661 only stops `main src/` from meaning 'folders only'. Result: `/notes/ todo` also returns meeting-notes/todo.txt and other/notes-todo.txt, in the default mode, while the manual (docs/manual.md:348-349) and the Search Syntax dialog (src/finder/dialogs.rs:963-964) promise 'Only paths inside a folder named notes'. The same query does filter with Kind = Document, Image and the rest, which parse with FileSearchConfig (engine.rs:740).
proposal: In search_root, before parsing in the Mixed and Dir branches, rewrite folder-filter tokens when the query has at least one other token: a token (optionally starting with `!`) with no glob characters that starts with `/` (and is longer than `/`) or ends with `/` becomes `**/<fold_case(segment)>/**`, where segment is the token without its outer slashes. fold_case (engine.rs:1652) keeps fff's case-blind segment matching (fff-search src/index/constraints.rs:26-38). Globs are enabled in both configs (config.rs:12-14), and globset reads `**/x/**` as inside a folder x at any depth. Then delete the reorder at 654-661: a rewritten query no longer ends in `/`, and a lone `src/` still does and keeps its 'folders only' meaning. fuzzy_text already drops both spellings, so `words`, highlighting and wants_apps are unchanged.
original_test_plan: Engine test: root with notes/todo.txt, meeting-notes/todo.txt, other/notes-todo.txt. With the default request (kind Any, files_only false), the file hits for `/notes/ todo` and for `todo notes/` are exactly notes/todo.txt (today all three come back). A lone `notes/` still returns only folders. With kind Folder and folders notes/todo-items and other/todo-items, `todo notes/` returns only the first.
original_risks: In Folder kind, whether the folder `notes` itself matches `**/notes/**` depends on fff's folder paths ending in `/` (join_rel trims one at engine.rs:1540, which suggests they do); either outcome is acceptable but the test should pin it. `!src/` changes from a substring exclusion (`src/` anywhere, so also `mysrc/`) to an exact folder exclusion.

verifier.claim_check:
The described behaviour is real; I could not run it (no cargo), so this is from reading the code path end to end.

- The window always sends `files_only: false` (src/finder/mod.rs:1380-1387); the server does too unless `type=file` (src/server/mod.rs:394-413).
- Any Kind parses with `MixedSearchConfig` (crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:711-713) and Folder with `DirSearchConfig` (696-697). Both return false from `enable_path_segments` (fff-query-parser-0.11.0/src/config.rs:218-221, 244-247), so in parser.rs:302-306 `/notes/` and `src/` fall through to plain text parts.
- Those parts are fuzzy-matched against the whole path with `max_typos = (len/4).clamp(2,6)` (fff-search-0.11.0/src/file_picker.rs:1113, 1200; score.rs:54-131, 308-383). `/notes/` (7 chars, 2 typos) therefore matches `meeting-notes/todo.txt` and `other/notes-todo.txt`. `src/` (4 chars, 2 typos) matches almost any nested path.
- The engine's own strict check never sees them: `fuzzy_text` drops tokens that start or end with `/` (engine.rs:1549-1561), so `words` at 548-551 and the retain at 570-580 only test `todo`. Turning Allow typos off does not help.
- The reorder at engine.rs:654-661 only stops `main src/` from tripping fff's dirs-only switch (file_picker.rs:1260-1261).
- File kinds do filter: engine.rs:740 uses `QueryParser::default()` (FileSearchConfig), giving `PathSegment` (parser.rs:302-306; fff-search-0.11.0/src/index/constraints.rs:337-340).
- It is not intentional. docs/manual.md:348-349, README.md:112 and src/finder/dialogs.rs:963-964 all promise "Only paths inside a folder named notes", and the comment at engine.rs:654-655 calls `main src/` a path filter. CHANGELOG.md has nothing on it.
- Related defect the candidate missed: in Any Kind `!src/` parses as `Not(Text("src/"))` (parser.rs:375-380), a substring exclusion that also drops `mysrc/…` and `meeting-notes/…`; `!/src/` does not exclude a top-level `src/` at all.

The proposed mechanism needs correcting on four points:
1. Deleting the reorder regresses typing. For `main /` the bare `/` is not rewritten, the query still ends in `/`, and the list flips to folders-only for a keystroke. The same happens for `main src*/`.
2. "At least one other token" must count the user's tokens. The scope glob is appended at engine.rs:649-652, so a lone `src/` in a folder-scoped search would otherwise change meaning.
3. Rewriting changes fff's `raw_query`, which is the key for the opened-before boost (file_picker.rs:1115-1127; score.rs:804-805 gives +1000 with the default `min_combo_count` 0). `track_open` records the typed query (engine.rs:1308-1312), so `/notes/ todo` would lose the boost it has today.
4. A glob forces a regex pass over every indexed path per keystroke (constraints.rs:427-429). A segment containing `}` or `\` fails to compile in globset (glob.rs:850, 866-867), which yields zero results.

The globset reading is otherwise right: `**/x/**` compiles to `^(?:/?|.*/)x/.*$` (globset-0.4.21/src/glob.rs:737-742), the build uses globset not zlob, and fff folder paths do end in `/` (file_picker.rs:236).
verifier.implementation_notes:
Do not rewrite tokens to globs. Use fff's own `PathSegment` constraint by parsing with a small custom `ParserConfig`. It is public, re-exported through `fff_search::*` (fff-query-parser-0.11.0/src/lib.rs:50-52; fff-search src/lib.rs:177), and `QueryParser::new` is generic over it.

1. In crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs add `ParserConfig` to the `fff_search` import and define, near `fuzzy_text`:
   - `#[derive(Clone, Copy)] struct FolderSearch { dirs: bool, folder_filters: bool }`
   - `enable_path_segments` returns `folder_filters`.
   - `enable_extension`, `enable_type_filter` and `enable_git_status` return `!dirs`.
   - With `folder_filters = false` this equals `DirSearchConfig` (dirs = true) or `MixedSearchConfig` (dirs = false).

2. In `search_root`, compute `let folder_filters = user.split_whitespace().count() > 1;` from `user` (line 637), before extensions and the scope glob are appended. A lone `src/`, `/notes/` or `!src/` then parses exactly as today, scoped or not.

3. Replace the two parsers:
   - Line 697: `QueryParser::new(FolderSearch { dirs: true, folder_filters }).parse(&query)`.
   - Line 712: the same with `dirs: false`.
   - `DirSearchConfig` and `MixedSearchConfig` drop out of the imports.

4. Keep the reorder at 654-661 unchanged. It is still what stops `main src/` (raw query ending in `/`) from going dirs-only, and it covers `main /` while typing.

5. Leave `fuzzy_text`, `words`, `wants_apps`, highlighting and `fold_glob_case` alone; they already treat these tokens as constraints.

What this gives:
- `/notes/ todo`, `todo notes/`, `/a/b/ x` and `!src/ main` produce `PathSegment` / `Not(PathSegment)` via parser.rs:301-306 and 362-373.
- The same constraint is applied to files and folders: `apply_constraints` is generic over `Constrainable`, and `DirItem` implements it (fff-search src/types.rs:224-245; score.rs:400-410, 608-618).
- Semantics match Document, Image and the other kinds: whole folder name, ASCII case-blind, multi-segment supported.
- No regex pass, and `raw_query` is unchanged for `/notes/ todo`.

Pitfall: the folder `notes` itself passes `PathSegment("notes")` because its stored path is `notes/` (constraints.rs:96-101). It only shows if it also matches the other words.

CHANGELOG.md: add a `### Fixed` section under `[Unreleased]` (it has only Added and Changed). Say that folder filters now work with Any Kind and Folder, and that `!src/` excludes only the folder named src.

Optional: one sentence in docs/manual.md after the syntax table saying the folder name must match whole (case ignored) and a lone `src/` lists folders.
verifier.test_plan:
Add an engine unit test in the `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` of crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs (starts at line 1779), copying the fixture pattern of `quoted_words_match_names_letter_for_letter` (1986-2044):
- temp dir `std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("fff-folder-filter-{}", std::process::id()))`
- `Engine::new(EngineOptions { roots: vec![dir.clone()], app_dirs: Vec::new(), db_dir: None, watch: false, search: Default::default() })`
- `assert!(engine.wait_ready(Duration::from_secs(10)))`
- a closure over `engine.search(&SearchRequest { query, kind, limit: 50, ..Default::default() })` returning paths relative to the root, sorted. `Default` gives `files_only: false`, the window's request.

Fixture, every folder holding a file: `notes/todo.txt`, `meeting-notes/todo.txt`, `other/notes-todo.txt`, `notes/todo-items/a.md`, `other/todo-items/b.md`.

Assertions:
1. Any Kind `/notes/ todo`: every hit is under `notes/`, `notes/todo.txt` is present, `meeting-notes/todo.txt` and `other/notes-todo.txt` are absent. By my reading all three come back today.
2. Any Kind `todo notes/` gives the same set as 1 and still contains the file `notes/todo.txt`, proving the kept reorder avoids folders-only.
3. `/NOTES/ todo` gives the same set as 1 (case-blind).
4. Any Kind lone `notes/`: non-empty, every hit `is_dir`, and `notes` is among them. Do not assert the exact set; the fuzzy match also returns `meeting-notes`.
5. Any Kind `todo !notes/`: contains `meeting-notes/todo.txt` and `other/notes-todo.txt`, and nothing under `notes/`. Today the substring exclusion also drops `meeting-notes/todo.txt`.
6. `KindFilter::Folder` with `todo notes/`: exactly `notes/todo-items`. Today `other/todo-items` also matches.
7. `KindFilter::Document` with `/notes/ todo`: unchanged, contains `notes/todo.txt` and not `meeting-notes/todo.txt`.

The headless UI harness in tests/common/mod.rs is not needed; the change is entirely in the engine. Existing assertions that must stay green:
- `finds_apps_without_indexing_them` (engine.rs:2149-2230) and `searches_a_folder` (2084-2146) use only slash-free tokens.
- tests/controls.rs:336-364, tests/finder.rs:67 and tests/server.rs:123 search `atlas` / `budget` only.
No test under tests/*.rs or in the engine pins the current fuzzy behaviour.
verifier.risks:
- `!src/` changes from a substring exclusion to an exact folder exclusion in Any Kind and Folder. This is the documented meaning; call it out in the changelog.
- In queries of two or more tokens, a token that starts or ends with `/` and also contains glob characters (`src*/`, `/src/**/*.rs`) becomes a literal `PathSegment` instead of a glob. Document, Image and the other kinds already behave this way. Today `/src/**` never matches anyway (relative paths have no leading `/`) and `src*/` matches only folders.
- A pasted absolute path plus a word (`/Users/me/Documents report`) goes from loose fuzzy matches to zero results unless that segment chain exists inside the search location. File kinds already do this.
- While a leading-slash folder name is half typed (`todo /no`), the list is empty until the name is complete. The trailing form (`todo notes/`) narrows smoothly.
- The opened-before boost is still missed for `main src/`, because the reorder changes the lookup key. That is pre-existing and not made worse.
- The "today" halves of the test assertions come from reading neo_frizbee's typo rule, not from a run. Check them once before the fix so the test is known to fail first.
